Sessions already open are not captured. Start a new one in an included project.
Check progress with agent-archive status.

To set up another Mac with this storage, run there:
  agent-archive setup --yes --provider s3 --bucket team-archive --aws-profile work --region us-east-1 --apps codex,claude,cursor --project ~/src/web-app
[exit 0]
